```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggcorrplot)
```

```{r}
Students=read.csv("StudentPerformanceFactors.csv")
```

```{r}
View(Students)
```

```{r}
glimpse(Students)
```

```{r}
colSums(is.na(Students))
```

```{r}
summary(Students)
```

```{r}
# The gap is calculated as the difference between Exam_Score and Previous_Scores
Students <- Students %>%
  mutate(PerformanceGap = Exam_Score - Previous_Scores)
```

```{r}
cor_matrix=cor(Students[, c("Exam_Score", "Previous_Scores", "Hours_Studied", "PerformanceGap", "Attendance", "Sleep_Hours")])

ggcorrplot(cor_matrix, lab = TRUE, lab_size = 3, method = "circle", type = "upper", 
           colors = c("red", "white", "blue"), title = "Correlation Heatmap of Student Performance Factors")
```

```{r}
#Histogram for the Exam_Score variable:
ggplot(Students, aes(x = Exam_Score)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 5, fill = "steelblue", color = "white") +
  labs(title = "Distribution of Exam Scores", x = "Exam Score", y = "Frequency")
```

```{r}
#The mean exam score
mean_score <- round(mean(Students$Exam_Score, na.rm = TRUE))

#Examines the relationship between Hours_Studied and Exam_Score
ggplot(Students, aes(x = Hours_Studied, y = Exam_Score)) + geom_point(color = "darkorange", size = 2.5) + geom_hline(yintercept = mean_score, linetype = "dashed", color = "black", linewidth = 1) +  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, color = "blue", linewidth = 1) +
  labs(title = "Study Time vs Exam Score", x = "Study Time", y = "Exam Score")
```
```{r}
#distribution of Exam_Score for each level of Parental_Involvement
ggplot(Students, aes(x = as.factor(Parental_Involvement), y = Exam_Score, fill = as.factor(Parental_Involvement))) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  labs( title = "Exam Score Distribution by Parental Involvement",
    x = "Parental Involvement", y = "Exam Score",
    fill = "Parental Involvement" ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14)
```
```{r}
#Exam_Score distribution across different Motivation_Level groups
```

```{r}
#Load the GGally package

```


```{r}
#Fit a linear regression model to predict Exam_Score using: Previous_Scores, Hours_Studied, Attendance, and Sleep_Hours

model_regrssion=lm(Exam_Score ~ Previous_Scores + Hours_Studied + Attendance + Sleep_Hours, data = Students)
summary(model_regrssion)

# Predict exam scores for each student using the fitted model
Students$Predicted_Score <- predict(model_regrssion)

# Calculate the mean exam score and mean predicted score (rounded for readability)
mean_actual <- round(mean(Students$Exam_Score, na.rm = TRUE))
mean_predicted <- round(mean(Students$Predicted_Score, na.rm = TRUE))

# Plot Actual vs. Predicted Exam Scores
# - Points represent individual students
ggplot(Students, aes(y = Exam_Score, x = Predicted_Score)) +
  geom_point(color = "blue", size = 3) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, color = "red", linewidth = 1) +
  labs(title = "Actual vs Predicted Exam Scores",
       y = "Actual Exam Score", x = "Predicted Exam Score")
```

```{r}
#Fit another linear regression model (model_regrssion2) using Sleep_Hours and Hours_Studied as predictors
model_regrssion2=lm(Exam_Score ~ + Sleep_Hours + Hours_Studied , data = Students)
summary(model_regrssion2)

Students$Predicted_Score2 <- predict(model_regrssion2)

ggplot(Students, aes(y = Exam_Score, x = Predicted_Score)) +

```

```{r}
#install.packages("caret")
library(caret)

#Add a new variable 'AboveAverage' to indicate if a student's Exam_Score is above the mean.
Students <- Students %>%
  mutate(AboveAverage = ifelse(Exam_Score > mean(Exam_Score, na.rm = TRUE), 1, 0))

# 80% for training and 20% for testing
train_index <- createDataPartition(Students$AboveAverage, p = 0.8, list = FALSE)
train_data <- Students[train_index, ]
test_data <- Students[-train_index, ]

# Fit a logistic regression model to predict AboveAverage
model_log <- glm(AboveAverage ~ Parental_Involvement + Extracurricular_Activities
 + Motivation_Level + Internet_Access + Family_Income + Teacher_Quality + School_Type + Peer_Influence + Parental_Education_Level + Distance_from_Home, 
                 data = train_data, family = "binomial")
summary(model_log)
```

```{r}
test_data$Predicted_Prob <- predict(model_log, newdata = test_data, type = "response")
test_data$Predicted_Class <- ifelse(test_data$Predicted_Prob > 0.5, 1, 0)

con <- table(Predicted = test_data$Predicted_Class, Actual = test_data$AboveAverage)
print(con)

#Calculate the prediction accuracy by comparing predicted and actual binary outcomes.
accuracy <- mean(test_data$Predicted_Class == test_data$AboveAverage)
print(paste("Accuracy:", round(accuracy, 3)))
```

```{r}
#density plot to visualize the distribution of predicted probabilities from the logistic model
ggplot(Students, aes(x = Predicted_Prob, fill = as.factor(AboveAverage))) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.5) +
  labs(title = "Distribution of Predicted Probabilities by Actual Class",
       x = "Predicted Probability of Scoring Above Average",
       fill = "Actual Class") +
  theme_minimal()
```
```{r}
# Create the confusion matrix for model_log
conf_matrix <- table(Predicted = test_data$Predicted_Class, Actual = test_data$AboveAverage)

# Convert the table to a data frame for ggplot
conf_df <- as.data.frame(conf_matrix)

# Create a column with labels for each cell
conf_df$Result <- with(conf_df, ifelse(Predicted == 0 & Actual == 0, "True Negative",
                              ifelse(Predicted == 1 & Actual == 1, "True Positive",
                              ifelse(Predicted == 1 & Actual == 0, "False Positive",
                              ifelse(Predicted == 0 & Actual == 1, "False Negative", NA)))))

# Combine the result label and the frequency
conf_df$Label <- paste(conf_df$Result, "\n", conf_df$Freq)

# Plot the confusion matrix with custom labels and colors
ggplot(conf_df, aes(x = as.factor(Actual), y = as.factor(Predicted), fill = Freq)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", size = 1) +
  geom_text(aes(label = Label), color = "black", size = 5) +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "#F7FBFF", high = "#08306B") +
  labs(
    title = "Confusion Matrix (Model Log)",
    x = "Actual Class",
    y = "Predicted Class",
    fill = "Frequency"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
    axis.title = element_text(face = "bold")
  )
```

```{r}
#Fit a reduced logistic regression model
model_log_reduced <- glm(AboveAverage ~ Parental_Involvement + Motivation_Level + Family_Income + Extracurricular_Activities + Peer_Influence + Parental_Education_Level + Teacher_Quality,
                         data = train_data, family = "binomial")

summary(model_log_reduced)
```
```{r}
#Predict probabilities on the test set using the reduced logistic model.
test_data$Predicted_Prob_Reduced <- predict(model_log_reduced, newdata = test_data, type = "response")
test_data$Predicted_Class_Reduced <- ifelse(test_data$Predicted_Prob_Reduced > 0.5, 1, 0)

con_reduced <- table(Predicted = test_data$Predicted_Class_Reduced, Actual = test_data$AboveAverage)
print(con_reduced)

# Calculate and print the accuracy of the reduced model.
accuracy_reduced <- mean(test_data$Predicted_Class_Reduced == test_data$AboveAverage)
print(paste("Reduced Model Accuracy:", round(accuracy_reduced, 3)))
```
```{r}
#distribution of predicted probabilities from the reduced logistic model
ggplot(test_data, aes(x = Predicted_Prob_Reduced, fill = as.factor(AboveAverage))) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.5) +
  labs(title = "Distribution of Predicted Probabilities by Actual Class",
       x = "Predicted Probability of Scoring Above Average",
       fill = "Actual Class") +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}

conf_matrix <- table(
  Predicted = test_data$Predicted_Class_Reduced, 
  Actual = test_data$AboveAverage
)

conf_df <- as.data.frame(conf_matrix)

conf_df$Result <- with(conf_df, ifelse(Predicted == "0" & Actual == "0", "True Negative",
                               ifelse(Predicted == "1" & Actual == "1", "True Positive",
                               ifelse(Predicted == "1" & Actual == "0", "False Positive",
                               ifelse(Predicted == "0" & Actual == "1", "False Negative", NA)))))


conf_df$Label <- paste(conf_df$Result, "\n", conf_df$Freq)


ggplot(conf_df, aes(x = as.factor(Actual), y = as.factor(Predicted), fill = Freq)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", size = 1) +
  geom_text(aes(label = Label), color = "black", size = 5) +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "#F7FBFF", high = "#08306B") +
  labs(
    title = "Confusion Matrix (Reduced Model)",
    x = "Actual Class",
    y = "Predicted Class",
    fill = "Frequency"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
    axis.title = element_text(face = "bold"))
```
